## Summary

What changes and why? Link the related issue.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (no real network access in tests)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, tests with coverage)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md and both READMEs updated when behavior changes
- [ ] Security defaults unchanged, or the change is explained (read-only default, host allowlist, env-only credentials)
- [ ] No personal data, credentials or local paths added
